# send_guest_invitation_tool

> Send a guest invitation email to join an LLM conversation.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `communication` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=send_guest_invitation_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Send a guest invitation email to join an LLM conversation. Recipients can view the full conversation and send multiple messages before signing up.

IMPORTANT DISTINCTION:
- This is for MULTI-MESSAGE GUEST TRIAL (allows multiple responses based on tenant configuration)
- Use send_conversation_invitation_tool for SINGLE-MESSAGE FEEDBACK (one response only, then token expires)
- This tool enables progressive engagement with configurable message limits (e.g., 1 → 5 → unlimited)
- Conversation invitation tool is ideal for one-time feedback or specific questions

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `email` | string | yes | Email address to send the invitation to. |
| `message` | string | no | Optional welcome message from the inviter. |
| `llm_conversation_id` | number | no | Optional if this tool was used in the scope of an LlmConversation it will use that LlmConversations Id, if not this must be passed. |
